tooltip.travelersring.tier.0: Teleports you to spawn for XP. Works in the Overworld.
tooltip.travelersring.tier.1: Half XP cost. Works in the Overworld and Nether (can also use your Respawn Anchor).
tooltip.travelersring.tier.2: Any dimension, any recorded spawnpoint. Keeps held items and armor on death and lets you choose where to respawn.
tooltip.travelersring.how_to_use: Equip in a Curios ring slot and press the Use Traveler's Ring key, or right-click while holding it.
